title: Vapouriz 50/50 Gold Tobacco 10ml
description: An endlessly satisfying and authentic tobacco flavour from the Vapouriz 50/50 collection, Gold Tobacco carries the rich, robust taste of Virginia rolling tobacco for a smooth and flavoursome vape every time. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the Vapouriz 50/50 E-Liquid collection and pick up the perfect pairing for any Starter Vape Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit. We have a selection of e-liquid formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options. What Is 50/50 E Liquid? 50/50 e-liquid is called so because it contains a 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol ratio, which allows for an extremely versatile vaping experience. These liquids can be used in Starter Vape Kits, High powered Sub Ohm Kits and Pod Vape Kits. For more information, check out the full 50/50 vape juice guide.
